newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers hesitate over V' chip.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers hesitate over V' chip.

text.p: European Union culture ministers reacted warily on Monday to European Parliament demands for a law to ensue V-chips be installed in all new television sets to help parents screen out violent programmes from their children.
"There's a general agreement that there should be some form of protection," said Irish Culture Minister Michael Higgins after the ministers met.
"There's a mixed view in relation to the efficiency of the technical measure which consists of the V-chip," he said, saying new studies would be needed.
The EU Culture Commissioner Marcelino Oreja said he expected the bloc's ministers and the parliament to have to go to the negotiating table early next year over the issue.
